text.ui.help.general.01: Lookout's slate: ; studies a place without spending a watch; a pointing hand turns the same glass.
text.ui.help.general.02: Witness roll: O records visible workers, beasts, duties, stores, and immediate dangers.
text.ui.help.general.03: Quartermaster's hand: F tests nearby material; work spends one watch, while Escape leaves it untouched.
text.ui.help.general.04: Regional ledger: Z opens the work account, its testimony, and the changes already gathering.
text.ui.help.general.05: Courier's field card: arrows, HJKL, and YUBN carry a traveller across the ground; the sightline travels with them.
text.ui.help.general.06: Pathfinder's cord: T follows a witnessed destination one ordinary step at a time; any mark cuts the cord.
text.ui.help.general.07: Deck orders: Enter or E handles what is near. A sets an attack line. G braces, reloads, or listens.
text.ui.help.general.08: Gangplank order: E steps ashore from Jomon. Tab presents the tug or a nearby interior; E boards a regional conveyance.
text.ui.help.general.09: Chart key: @ courier, a ally, v visitor, c/M witnesses, h/g/x/b threats, X claimant, R cargo, C sealed store.
text.ui.help.general.10: Warned ground: a reversed ! is an observed prepared blow; a courier standing in it is marked the same way.
text.ui.help.general.11: Survey key: ~ water, # wall, + door, <> stair, ^ roof, & working control, O drop, d weak floor.
text.ui.help.general.12: Cabin custom: speak beside a person to change courier or invite aid; C consults the tavern support, P sets a chart course.
text.ui.help.general.13: Pack ledger: I opens a pack or locker to shift, turn, pass, carry, bind, or set aside a physical thing.
text.ui.help.general.14: Courier's marks: P opens learned disciplines; D brings spellwork and shrine vigil to hand; W calls for work and flasks.
text.ui.help.general.15: A quiet, near shore and light pack draw little notice; time, distance, noise, and valuables do otherwise.
text.ui.help.general.16: Bright ground lies in present sight; dim ground is remembered; blank ground has not yet been witnessed.
text.ui.help.general.17: Brace against readable intent. Smoke spoils aim. Mud, water, machinery, height, and walls decide the footing.
text.ui.help.general.18: Master's leave book: Q asks for departure. Escape folds the current paper without leaving a mark.
text.ui.help.inventory.01: Pack clerk: arrows/WASD move; Enter lift/place; R turn; Space mark; */K sort.
text.ui.help.inventory.02: Body clerk: T pass E equip O pack P pin Z stow [] body D drop C bind Esc fold.
text.ui.help.target.01: Arms slate: arrows/HJKL Tab mark <> deck M lore Enter fire G brace Esc fold.
text.ui.help.route.01: Chart clerk: arrows/WASD/HJKL follow lines; Enter reads; Tab turns; Esc folds.
text.ui.help.route.02: Mark a harbour; mark twice to sail when water allows. No crossing is promised.

text.ui.help.base.02: Jomon: P lore W work X gear F stock D spell V speak R return I Z O witness ? Q
text.ui.help.look.01: Lookout's glass: arrows/HJKL study <> deck point hand Esc/; fold — no watch.
